## Week 1 · Introduction to Virtual Assistants

### Slide 1: What is a Virtual Assistant?

> **Definition**: Software applications designed to interact with users via natural language (**text or speech**) to satisfy tasks or answer inquiries.

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
#### 3 Primary System Architectures

1. **Event Classifiers**  
   Single-input categorization engines  
   _Example:_ spam filtering, support ticket routing

2. **Command Interpreters**  
   Action-oriented, usually single-turn systems  
   _Example:_ “Turn off the living room lights.”

3. **Conversational AI**  
   Multi-turn dialogue agents that maintain context
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}
![AI assistant use patterns infographic](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516116216624-53e697fedbea?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80){fig-alt="Abstract visualization of AI assistant architectures"}

- 🏷️ **Classifier**: categorize
- ⚡ **Command**: execute
- 💬 **Conversational AI**: track context and respond across turns
:::
:::

## Week 1 · Introduction to Virtual Assistants

### Slide 2: Primary Enterprise Use Cases

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
- **Self-Service Automation**  
  Direct customer resolution without human intervention  
  _Examples:_ checking balance, password reset

- **Agent Assist**  
  Embedded AI support for human agents with:
  - real-time recommendations
  - document retrieval
  - compliance checks

- **Classification & Routing**  
  Triage raw inputs to correct human teams or backend queues
:::
::: {.column width="40%"}
![Enterprise support use cases infographic](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552664730-d307ca884978?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80){fig-alt="Enterprise customer support and operations image"}

🧭 **Input** → Self-Service | Agent Assist | Routing
:::
:::

## Week 2 · Building Your First Virtual Assistant

### Slide 1: Core Mechanics — Intents and Entities

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="54%"}
- **Intents** = user’s goal/action (**verb-focused**)  
  _Examples:_ `#Check_Balance`, `#Track_Order`, `#Cancel_Subscription`

- **Entities** = contextual details (**nouns/metadata**) that complete intent meaning

**Example Utterance:**  
“What is the status of order #98723?”

- Intent → `#Track_Order`
- Entity → `@OrderNumber = 98723`
:::
::: {.column width="46%"}
![Intent and entity extraction illustration](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526374965328-7f61d4dc18c5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80){fig-alt="Data extraction and NLP illustration"}

- 🎯 Intent: `#Track_Order`
- 🏷️ Entity: `@OrderNumber=98723`
- ✅ Combined for dialogue decision
:::
:::

## Week 2 · Building Your First Virtual Assistant

### Slide 2: Multi-Turn Dialogue & Slot Filling

1. **Simple Q&A**  
   Immediate response from recognized intent

2. **Conditioned Responses**  
   Output changes using entities/rules  
   _Example:_ if `@AccountType == "Checking"`, return checking-specific response

3. **Slot Filling**  
   Gather all required fields before API execution

![Multi-turn conversation flow infographic](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551434678-e076c223a692?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80){fig-alt="Team collaborating over workflow and conversation steps"}

💬 Request → ❓Clarify slots → 🧾 Collect values → 🔌 API call → ✅ Confirmation

## Week 2 · Building Your First Virtual Assistant

### Slide 3: Basic Error Management

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="57%"}
#### Confidence Thresholds (\(P_{intent}\))

- **\(P \ge 0.75\)** → Execute intent response directly
- **\(0.40 \le P < 0.75\)** → Ask for confirmation/disambiguation
- **\(P < 0.40\)** → Trigger fallback recovery node

#### Two-Strikes Rule

If the assistant fails to understand **two consecutive turns**, immediately:

- move to robust fallback, or
- transfer to a human agent
:::
::: {.column width="43%"}
![Error handling and escalation illustration](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516321497487-e288fb19713f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80){fig-alt="Decision and escalation concept"}

- 🟢 High confidence: answer directly
- 🟡 Medium confidence: clarify
- 🔴 Low confidence: fallback
- 🧑‍💼 Two failures: handoff to human
:::
:::

## ✅ Part 1 Recap

- Virtual assistants range from **classifiers** to **full conversational systems**
- Enterprise value appears in **self-service**, **agent assist**, and **routing**
- Core NLP design starts with **intents + entities**
- Real assistants need **multi-turn slot filling** and **error policies**
